title: Uttar Pradesh Transport Department compounding schedule

Parking and road use: Unsignaled lane or alignment change, subject to the listed §184 exclusions
Using a handheld communication device while driving
Driving with a known condition that makes the driving dangerous
Unauthorized race or speed trial in a public place
Failing to give free passage to an emergency vehicle
Unnecessary, continuous or excessive horn use
Using a horn in a prohibited area
Driving with an exhaust cutout that bypasses the silencer
Riders, restraints and passengers: Carrying more passengers than the registration or permit allows
Driver or passenger without a seat belt
Child under 14 without a seat belt or child restraint
Motorcycle carrying more than one passenger in addition to the driver
Documents, licensing and authority: Failure to produce requested vehicle or driver documents, including accepted electronic documents
Using another state's registration mark for more than 12 months
Giving a driving licence to another person
Disobeying a lawful direction or obstructing an authorized official
Refusing required information or knowingly giving false information
Allowing an ineligible person to drive
Driving in contravention of licence or minimum-age requirements
Driving while disqualified from holding or obtaining a driving licence
Working as a stage-carriage conductor while disqualified
Operating without a valid fitness certificate
Displaying the registration mark in a non-prescribed manner
Operating without a permit or contrary to route, area or purpose conditions
Driving or allowing operation of an uninsured vehicle
Unauthorized interference with or tampering with a vehicle
Commercial vehicles and fares: Charging more than the permitted fare
Failing to display required transport-vehicle information
Nonworking fare meter in a motor cab
Travelling without a valid ticket or pass, or refusing to show it on request
Conductor fare, ticket issuance, ticket validity, under-ticketing or ticket-checking offence
Contract carriage unlawfully refusing to operate or carry passengers
Vehicle standards and loads: Manufacturer, importer or dealer supplying, modifying or offering a noncompliant vehicle
Selling, offering or permitting sale of a noncompliant critical safety component
Owner making a prohibited vehicle alteration
Registering a vehicle that breaches prescribed dimension rules
Contravening rules for issuing a fitness certificate
Operating in breach of road-safety standards, such as reflector or speed limiter requirements
Operating in breach of prescribed air-pollution standards
Operating in breach of prescribed noise standards
Operating above the permissible vehicle weight
Carrying a load projecting beyond permitted dimensions
Refusing to stop for weighing or removing load before weighing
Other: Other contravention for which no specific penalty is prescribed
